def transform(grid):
    n=len(grid); out=[[7]*n for _ in range(n)]
    # preserve original vertical separator columns outside the three output rows
    zero_cols={c for r in range(n) for c in range(n) if grid[r][c]==0}
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==5]
    center=(min(r for r,c in pts)+max(r for r,c in pts))//2
    for r in range(n):
        for c in zero_cols: out[r][c]=0
    for c in range(2,n-2): out[center][c]=5
    for c in range(n): out[center-1][c]=out[center+1][c]=0
    return out
